scripts.{{ .ServiceName }}-cli:
#!/bin/sh
PASS="$(cat "${{ upper .ServiceName }}_PASSWORD_FILE")"
DB="${{{ upper .ServiceName }}_DATABASE:-0}"
case "$DB" in *[!0-9]*) DB=0 ;; esac
redli -u "redis://${{{ upper .ServiceName }}_USER}:${PASS}@${{{ upper .ServiceName }}_HOST}:${{{ upper .ServiceName }}_PORT}/${DB}" "$@"; echo

dataVolume.name: {{ .AppName }}-{{ .ServiceName }}-data
dataVolume.description: Redis data directory (optional, for RDB/AOF persistence)
